title: Torsion abelian sheaf on the small etale site
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme and $F$ an abelian sheaf on the small etale site of $T$, i.e. an object of $\Ab(T_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. For an integer $n\ge1$ let $F[n]=\ker(n:F\to F)$ [def-pur-abelian-sheaf-kernel] be the kernel of multiplication by $n$, the subsheaf of sections killed by $n$. Order the positive integers by divisibility; this poset is directed ($\operatorname{lcm}(n,m)$ bounds $n$ and $m$), and for $n\mid m$ one has $F[n]\subseteq F[m]$, so $n\mapsto F[n]$ with the inclusions is a filtered diagram in $\Ab(T_{\Et})$, and the inclusions $F[n]\hookrightarrow F$ induce a canonical map

$$
 c_F:\varinjlim_{n}F[n]\longrightarrow F
$$

from its colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] in $\Ab(T_{\Et})$. The sheaf $F$ is *torsion* (a *torsion abelian sheaf*) if $c_F$ is an isomorphism.

source.place: unit sk-def-pbc, statement ('Here a sheaf of abelian groups F on X_et is torsion if the canonical map colim_n F[n] -> F ... is an isomorphism'); also def-weil-pbc-property.md, detailed form; cf. Stacks Project, Etale cohomology, Section 0DDB (Torsion sheaves), proof of Lemma 'torsion-cohomology': F = union of F[d]
